16:   def self.hasUseText(item)

20:   # Shows "Use" option in Bag.
21:   def self.hasOutHandler(item)

50:   # Returns text to display instead of "Use"
51:   def self.getUseText(item)
52:     return UseText.trigger(item)
53:   end
54: 
55:   # Return value:
56:   # 0 - Item not used
57:   # 1 - Item used, don't end screen
58:   # 2 - Item used, end screen
59:   def self.triggerUseFromBag(item)
60:     return UseFromBag.trigger(item) if UseFromBag[item]
61:     # No UseFromBag handler exists; check the UseInField handler if present
62:     if UseInField[item]
63:       return (UseInField.trigger(item)) ? 1 : 0
64:     end
65:     return 0
66:   end
67: 
68:   # Returns whether item can be used
69:   def self.triggerConfirmUseInField(item)
70:     return true if !ConfirmUseInField[item]
71:     return ConfirmUseInField.trigger(item)
72:   end
73: 
74:   # Return value:
75:   # -1 - Item effect not found
76:   # 0  - Item not used
77:   # 1  - Item used
78:   def self.triggerUseInField(item)
79:     return -1 if !UseInField[item]
80:     return (UseInField.trigger(item)) ? 1 : 0
81:   end
82: 
83:   # Returns whether item was used
84:   def self.triggerUseOnPokemon(item, qty, pkmn, scene)
85:     return false if !UseOnPokemon[item]
86:     return UseOnPokemon.trigger(item, qty, pkmn, scene)
87:   end
88: 
89:   # Returns the maximum number of the item that can be used on the Pokémon at once.
90:   def self.triggerUseOnPokemonMaximum(item, pkmn)
91:     return 1 if !UseOnPokemonMaximum[item]
92:     return 1 if !Settings::USE_MULTIPLE_STAT_ITEMS_AT_ONCE
93:     return [UseOnPokemonMaximum.trigger(item, pkmn), 1].max
94:   end

96:   def self.triggerCanUseInBattle(item, pkmn, battler, move, firstAction, battle, scene, showMessages = true)
97:     return true if !CanUseInBattle[item]   # Can use the item by default
98:     return CanUseInBattle.trigger(item, pkmn, battler, move, firstAction, battle, scene, showMessages)
99:   end
100: 
101:   def self.triggerUseInBattle(item, battler, battle)

114:     return BattleUseOnPokemon.trigger(item, pkmn, battler, choices, scene)
115:   end
